description: Public API and verified search/preview bots: skip browser checks
expression: (http.host in {"cpchub.net" "www.cpchub.net"}) and ((http.request.uri.path eq "/api" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/")) or (cf.client.bot and cf.verified_bot_category in {"Search Engine Crawler" "Page Preview"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/install/" "/donate/" "/developers/" "/robots.txt" "/security.txt" "/.well-known/security.txt" "/sitemap.xml"} or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sitemap-") and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".xml")) or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/items/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/creators/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/share/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/static/"))))
